notes.title: Last Patch for Cloudy Valley!!
notes.content:
[b]Hey adventurers,[/b]

It took me a while to release this patch, but here it is!
I’ve worked on a few things to improve tCloudy Valley experience.

Honestly, I don't remember everything I did 😅 BUT I did add a feature for everyone who gets stuck somewhere! :D

That said, I'm actually done with Cloudy Valley — I can't really keep working on it — I need to take care of my mental health before burning out again.

So I hope you’ll still enjoy playing the game, even if it’s a bit buggy ^^'


Thank you all for your support and for all your kind (and even not-so-kind) reviews!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Some news
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello Adventurers of the Cloudy Valley Archipelago![/b][/i]

I took some time off this month to rest and recharge, but I’m thrilled to see that the game has reached so many players and that many of you are enjoying it! :)
As Cloudy Valley is the first game I’ve ever made, I’m so glad that so many people have played and enjoyed it. ❤️ It was a lot of work, I made plenty of mistakes, and I poured so much of myself into it.

However, I noticed that some of you encountered bugs and issues that were completely game- or fun-breaking... I’m really sorry about that!

I’ll be working on a new patch to address these problems and make Cloudy Valley a more stable game, so you can enjoy it without being ambushed by a wild bug. :)

Also, if you’ve had any issues with your inventory, feel free to DM me on X or any other social network so I can help fix the problem. Unfortunately, this is an issue I can’t fix globally...

I hope many of you will continue to enjoy Cloudy Valley!

Thank you for your trust and patience.

[i]Su[/i]

notes.title: Patch v1.02.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Correction of the climbing bug: This bug has been reported frequently! I encountered some issues while fixing it, and it took me some time to figure out how to proceed, but it should work now.
[*] Fix for the "You did it!" achievement: This achievement, which you unlock when picking up your first golden clover, should now work properly.
[*] Correction for Louise's quest: Previously, you couldn't give her a Golden Clover even if you had two in your inventory. This issue has been resolved, and the quest should now work as intended. :D
[/list]

I'm still working on some fixes, but I'm a bit tired since I've been working on this game non-stop for almost 1.5 years. I'm taking my time to ensure these corrections are done right. I apologize for the inconvenience and hope you're still enjoying the game!

Enjoy your adventure!

notes.title: Achievements + Patch v1.02.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the endgame scene where Pix was floating sitting in the air
[*] Added eyes to the sheep (> References to someone who said that putting eyes would be better)

[/list]
Enjoy your adventure!

I’m still hunting for more issues to fix, so feel free to let me know if you spot any!

notes.title: Cloudy Valley is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey, explorers!

Today is the day! Cloudy Valley is now out on Steam! Thank you so much for your support throughout development. I also want to thank everyone who helped bring this solo project to life. The feedback I received from the demo was incredibly helpful and played a big role in improving the game for launch.

And to celebrate the launch, Cloudy Valley is [b]10% off[/b] until November 28!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600720/Cloudy_Valley/

Oh, by the way, you can also buy Cloudy Valley in a [b]bundle with Minami Lane[/b], a game made by my friends Doot & Blibloop!

For the past few months, I've been busy working on the game to rework a lot of aspects:
[list]
[*] Revamped the opening, quests, dialogues, items, and sound design
[*] Improved graphics with better textures and colors
[*] Added new characters, areas, and secrets to discover
[*] Polished quality of life features, fixed bugs, and optimized performance
[/list]
I hope you’ll love exploring everything that’s been added. Your feedback is always welcome and appreciated—it helps me make the game even better!

Now, go start your adventure! Meet locals, explore freely, fish, find treasures, dig for secrets, grow sunflowers, and take on the main quest: finding a golden clover for your papa. Along the way, you can collect hats, shells, and mushrooms and even climb to new heights with your climbing shoes and sticks!

notes.title: Cloudy Valley is launching November 18!
notes.content:
Hey, explorers!

I'm so excited to announce that Cloudy Valley is officially [b]launching on November 18[/b]! The game has come a long way since the demo, thanks to all your fantastic feedback and suggestions. Initially, I planned for a January 2025 launch, but with the progress I've made, I decided to bring the release date forward!

Since the demo, I've been hard at work [b]revamping many aspects[/b] of the game: beginning of the game, quests, dialogues, items, sound design, and graphics by improving textures and colors. I designed and added new characters, areas, and discoveries to make Cloudy Valley a nicer experience for everyone compared to what you could discover in the demo. I've also polished the game with quality of life features, bug fixing, and optimization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800218/4887bdf8cb0ca7687efd92c92f3a8aaa12939669.png[/img]
[i]A before and after comparison with the starting area. Don't worry, Sheep Island hasn't disappeared, but it's further away from this area! As you can see, I made it less linear and wider. I hope you'll like these changes![/i]

With the full game so close to launch, I wanted to let you know that I've chosen to [b]take down the demo[/b]. During development, I realized [b]the game evolved[/b] into something much more polished and expanded, and it's now very, and I would even say [b]too different from the demo version[/b]. I’m grateful for your support and comments. I know some of you really enjoyed the demo, and I [b]thank you for your feedback[/b], which made a huge difference!

Now, starting November 18, you’ll be able to meet locals, explore freely, fish, find treasures, dig for secrets, grow sunflowers, and take on the main quest: finding a golden clover for your papa. Along the way, you can collect hats, shells, and mushrooms and even climb to new heights with your climbing shoes and sticks!

notes.title: Demo for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey there, explorers!

[b]Steam Next Fest[/b] is around the corner, and I'm thrilled to announce that Cloudy Valley will be part of this October Edition! This is the perfect opportunity to dive in the big blue in Cloudy Valley with the demo!

I also have a big announcement to make, Cloudy Valley will [b]launch in November 2024[/b], two months earlier than expected! Plus, we’ve just [b]hit 3,000 wishlists[/b]—a huge milestone, thanks to all of you! Let’s keep pushing to hit 6,000 wishlists for the best visibility when the game launches! And I commissioned two artists, Bleizc and Y0lully, to make the key art and Steam capsules of Cloudy Valley, here is the new key art!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800218/3336aef4108183ecfa5e4f4db7cd2a1274b33f5a.png[/img]

[h3]Now, what's in the demo?[/h3]

Play as Pix, a young girl attending a summer camp on the Cloudy Valley archipelago. Get ready to:
[list]
[*] [b]Explore the islands[/b]: Run down the hills, swim to go to every corner of the islands, and learn how to climb.
[*] [b]Collect hats and treasures[/b]: Start your very own collection of hats and gather seashells along the shorelines.
[*] [b]Meet new friends[/b]: Befriend the locals and other kids, listen to their problems and help them!
[/list]
Take your time to wander through the archipelago, listen to the waves, and enjoy the calming sounds of nature. You’re free to explore at your own pace in a laid-back atmosphere.

The demo is fully available in both [b]French[/b] and [b]English[/b].

[b]Download the demo now![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600720/Cloudy_Valley/

Start your adventure today! I can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see you all enjoying the serenity of Cloudy Valley during this Steam Next Fest!

Enjoy! Support Cloudy Valley by adding it to your wishlist!

notes.title: New demo!
notes.content:
Hey there, explorers!

I'm so excited to see Cloudy Valley part of the [b]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/b] (August 15-21). For this occasion, I [b]updated the demo[/b]!

You play as Pix, a girl going on a summer camp at the Cloudy Valley archipelago! Swim, climb, and explore the different islands. Discover treasures or enjoy a cozy and relaxing atmosphere by the waves.

The demo is available in [b]French[/b] and [b]English[/b].

Download the demo on the Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600720/Cloudy_Valley/ 


You can explore some of the islands in the archipelago, learn to climb, swim between islands, and even start a small collection of hats. Clean the shores, hunt and collect seashells, and other treasures. Befriend the locals and other kids at the camp, and more!

Take your time to discover the archipelago and do what you feel like in a calm and soothing atmosphere, lulled by the sound of nature and the waves.


[h3]Patch Note: Demo v2[/h3]

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] Added emotions for characters and Pix depending on dialogues and situations
[*] Added an animation on Pix when the inventory is open
[*] Added a small special easter egg for the demo
[*] Added landscapes
[*] Language settings (to switch from Fr/Eng)
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Some improvements to the water textures to make it more interesting
[*] Changed the eyes of all characters
[*] Changed some dialogues and some quests
[*] Changed the display of elements in the distance
[*] Changed the sky and general lighting
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs for Idle Break that were launching in a loop
[*] Fixed the localization bug that put the game in French only
[/list]
